title: The Kerala Fiscal Responsibility Act, 2003
full_text: The Kerala Fiscal Responsibility Act, 2003 2003-ലെ കേരള ധനസംബന്ധമായ ഉത്തരവാദിത്ത ആക്റ്റ് Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 200329 Act Number: 29 Enactment Date: 2003-09-17 Act Year: 2003 Short Title: The Kerala Fiscal Responsibility Act, 2003 Hindi Title: 2003-ലെ കേരള ധനസംബന്ധമായ ഉത്തരവാദിത്ത ആക്റ്റ് Long Title: An Act to provide for the responsibility of the Government to ensure prudence in fiscal management and fiscal stability by progressive elimination of revenue deficit and sustainable debt management consistent with fiscal stability, greater transparency in fiscal operations of the Government and conduct of fiscal policy in a medium term fiscal frame work and for matters connected therewith or incidental thereto.
